settings.repere: Texte · Based on a 60-day clinical study conduct
settings.text: Based on a 60-day clinical study conducted by Citruslabs (March 2026) on The Complete System for Acne-Prone Skin. Single-group, open-label design with participants aged 18 to 45 and self-reported acne concerns. No placebo control group. Percentages reflect the proportion of participants a board-certified dermatologist graded as showing improvement from baseline at day 60. Individual results may vary.

Self-reported participant perceptions from the same 60-day clinical study. Percentages reflect participants who agreed with the corresponding statement at the stated timepoint. These are subjective participant reports, not clinical diagnoses.
